answer: An AI-agent economy can limit Sybil identities using an optical physical unclonable function. For each challenge, a token fires a laser pulse at a queried angle through a disordered glass prism, and a sensor maps the speckle pattern via a fuzzy extractor to derive a signing key. Because microscopic scatterers resist cloning, attackers must buy a dedicated optical module per identity. However, shock during a freight voyage or thermal drift can shift alignment and break verification.
